components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single committed action on a surface — save, start, submit.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--ui); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; padding: 5px 9px; height: 28px; color: #fff; background: var(--accent-solid); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); box-shadow: var(--elev-1); cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-solid-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The alternative next to a primary; raised on a hairline.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--ui); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; padding: 5px 9px; height: 28px; color: var(--text); background: var(--bg-raised); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); box-shadow: var(--hairline); cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Rail Button
components.description: Icon-only navigation on the 52px rail; the active item takes a soft iris plate.
components.html: <button class="ds-rail-button ds-rail-active" aria-pressed="true"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M15 3H7a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v11"></path><rect x="9" y="6" width="11" height="15" rx="2"></rect></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-rail-button { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; color: var(--text-muted); background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius); cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-rail-button:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--bg-hover); } .ds-rail-active { color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); } .ds-rail-active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -8px; top: 8px; bottom: 8px; width: 3px; border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0; background: var(--accent); }

components.name: File Row
components.description: A 26px tree row; the open file is marked by a soft plate and a 2px accent edge.
components.html: main.typ
components.css: .ds-file-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 26px; padding: 0 10px; font-family: var(--ui); font-size: 12px; color: var(--text); border-left: 2px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-file-row:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); } .ds-file-row-active { background: var(--accent-soft); border-left-color: var(--accent); } .ds-file-name { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Menu Item
components.description: A dropdown row; hover fills with the solid accent and carries a mono shortcut.
components.css: .ds-menu-item { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: var(--ui); font-size: 12px; padding: 6px 9px; color: var(--text); background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-menu-item:hover { background: var(--accent-solid); color: #fff; } .ds-menu-label { flex: 1 1 auto; } .ds-menu-kbd { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-faint); } .ds-menu-item:hover .ds-menu-kbd { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.78); }

components.name: Command Palette Row
components.description: The active result in the command palette: a full iris plate with white ink.
components.css: .ds-palette-item { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; font-family: var(--ui); font-size: 13px; padding: 7px 10px; color: var(--text); background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-palette-item:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); } .ds-palette-active { background: var(--accent-solid); color: #fff; } .ds-palette-hint { margin-left: auto; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-faint); } .ds-palette-active .ds-palette-hint { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.78); }

components.name: Switch
components.description: A 36×20 setting toggle; the on state fills with solid iris.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 36px; height: 20px; padding: 0; background: var(--bg-inset); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-switch-knob { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--text-faint); box-shadow: var(--elev-1); transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-switch-on { background: var(--accent-solid); border-color: var(--accent-solid); } .ds-switch-on .ds-switch-knob { transform: translateX(16px); background: #fff; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A mono pill in the 28px status bar; error and warning chips carry tinted backgrounds.
components.html: 3 warnings
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; height: 20px; padding: 0 8px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--text-muted); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); } .ds-status-chip-warn { color: var(--warn); background: var(--warn-soft); }

narrative.overview: glyph is a typesetting tool, so its interface is held to the standard it exists to produce. The chrome behaves like a precision instrument: quiet at rest, exact under the hand, and honest about state at every moment. It is dense without being cramped, and layered without decoration. The system is deliberately restrained: one typeface family carries labels, headings, body, and controls; a single mono carries code, paths, and every measured value. One accent, iris, appears only where interaction or current state lives.
keyCharacteristics: Measurement is monospaced; prose and labels are not.
Depth is real (offset + blur + a one-pixel top highlight), never a zero-offset halo.
The accent is a signal, not a surface treatment.
Every state is designed: hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, empty, error.
Browser surfaces — selection, caret, scrollbars, focus rings — wear the palette.

rules.name: The Rare Accent Rule
rules.body: Iris covers well under 10% of any screen. Its scarcity is what makes "this is active" legible at a glance.

rules.name: The Two-Theme Rule
rules.body: A token change must make sense in both themes. Inverting a surface relationship is allowed; changing the relationship between accent and state is not.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: If a value is counted, timed, or positioned, it is set in the mono with tabular numerals. If it is read, it is set in Geist.

rules.name: The Real Light Rule
rules.body: Every raised surface carries both a shadow and a top highlight. A shadow alone reads as a sticker; the highlight is what makes it a plane.

dos: Do set every counted or positioned value in Geist Mono with tabular-nums.
Do keep every hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, empty, and error state designed.
Do theme the browser's own surfaces: ::selection, caret-color, accent-color, scrollbars, and focus rings all read from the palette.
Do let a raised plane be lighter than the plane below it, with a 1px top highlight.
Do keep functional text at 11px or larger; reserve 10px for kbd and non-interactive micro-labels.
donts: Don't use the accent for anything that is not interaction or current state.
Don't put a thick colored border on one side of a card, list item, or alert.
Don't reach for a display face in buttons, labels, or data.
Don't use mono as a costume for "technical".
Don't ship a spinner where a skeleton can hold the shape of the content.
Don't introduce a token that only works in one theme.
